text: On the left side of the pitch near the halfway line on Redmond Rovers’ own half, Rory Mensah receives a medium pass from Kian Coleman about 26 metres from Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the far end. After a patient buildup of six passes lasting almost 20 seconds, Mensah winds up and shoots with his foot from that distance. The ball sails into the net, leveling the score at 1-1. This goal showcases Redmond Rovers’ high pressing and quick passing style, breaking down Ironvale’s deep defense and giving Mensah a chance from a low-probability shot. [#682] [#685] [#689] [#690]
